title: Duterte defense assertions ahead of Nov. 30 trial 'superfluous,' won’t be 'meritorious'—ICC assistant to counsel
summary: The assertions of former President Rodrigo Duterte's lawyers ahead of his November 30 trial at the International Criminal Court will not be "meritorious" at this point in his case, ICC assistant to…

blocks.text: The assertions of former President Rodrigo Duterte's lawyers ahead of his November 30 trial at the International Criminal Court will not be "meritorious" at this point in his case, ICC assistant to counsel Ross Tugade said Friday, adding that the statements were merely "superfluous."
